admission.justification: Matching only a family subject or treating a declaration as delivery could hide the wrong effect or a requirement from another packet. Exact effect/reference reconciliation keeps those obligations visible without fabricating task authority.

applicability: Expected-knowledge-effect schema validation and reconciliation of one leaf's declarations against its candidate history.
conditions: A family declaration is delivered only by a changed FamilyRow whose actual effect equals the declaration; invariant changed/retire rows retain their own matching rules.

When typed approved packet references are listed in the task document, declared requirementRef spellings must belong to their stableId/version set; the added check does not apply when that typed set is empty.
An unmatched declaration remains an explicit planned obligation unless answered through its admitted planned row, rather than being silently completed by a similarly named row.
L54's own declared invariant strengthening still needs actual delivery or its admitted answer at real closeout; this source-backed record is not that delivery.
exclusions: The model does not approve or resolve requirement packets and declarations do not certify their own fulfillment.
No held invariant revision, task declaration edit, closeout or acceptance is performed by this publication.
statement: Declared family effects match their actual changed-row effect and packet references, while this leaf’s declared invariant strengthening must still be delivered or answered at its real closeout.
